pages.quiz:
CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #8
====

GRADE: Grade 1
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Bible Story: Holy Bible? (1 mark)
   A. Use Bible Story: Holy Bible to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Bible Story: Holy Bible with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Bible Story: Holy Bible.
   D. Say Bible Story: Holy Bible has no place in daily life.

2. Which response best shows understanding of Healing of of Jesus Christ? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Healing of of Jesus Christ.
   B. Say Healing of of Jesus Christ has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Healing of of Jesus Christ to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of Healing of of Jesus Christ with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

3. Which response best shows understanding of Jesus Christ? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Jesus Christ.
   B. Apply the teaching of Jesus Christ with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Say Jesus Christ has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Jesus Christ to insult classmates of other faiths.

4. Which response best shows understanding of Creation of Plants and Animals? (1 mark)
   A. Say Creation of Plants and Animals has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Creation of Plants and Animals to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Creation of Plants and Animals with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Creation of Plants and Animals.

5. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Waste food daily
   B. Pollute rivers deliberately
   C. Destroy trees without planting
   D. Care for the environment and use resources wisely

6. Which response best shows understanding of Physical? (1 mark)
   A. Say Physical has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Physical to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Physical.
   D. Apply the teaching of Physical with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

7. Which response best shows understanding of Baptism of Jesus Jesus Christ? (1 mark)
   A. Use Baptism of Jesus Jesus Christ to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Baptism of Jesus Jesus Christ.
   C. Say Baptism of Jesus Jesus Christ has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Baptism of Jesus Jesus Christ with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

8. Which response best shows understanding of Self- Awareness 1.0 Creation? (1 mark)
   A. Use Self- Awareness 1.0 Creation to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Say Self- Awareness 1.0 Creation has no place in daily life.
   C. Apply the teaching of Self- Awareness 1.0 Creation with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Self- Awareness 1.0 Creation.

9. Which response best shows understanding of My 1.0 Creation? (1 mark)
   A. Say My 1.0 Creation has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing My 1.0 Creation.
   C. Use My 1.0 Creation to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of My 1.0 Creation with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

10. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Skipping all moral lessons
   B. Refusing to help a neighbour
   C. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   D. Mocking other people’s beliefs

11. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   B. Cheating in exams
   C. Spreading rumours
   D. Hiding stolen items

12. Which response best shows understanding of Wedding? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Wedding.
   B. Say Wedding has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Wedding to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of Wedding with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain The Bible Story; and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Jesus Christ and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Baptism of Jesus Jesus Christ and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Wedding and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
MARKING SCHEME
====

1. B — Apply the teaching of Bible Story: Holy Bible with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

2. D — Apply the teaching of Healing of of Jesus Christ with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

3. B — Apply the teaching of Jesus Christ with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

4. C — Apply the teaching of Creation of Plants and Animals with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

5. D — Care for the environment and use resources wisely

6. D — Apply the teaching of Physical with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

7. D — Apply the teaching of Baptism of Jesus Jesus Christ with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

8. C — Apply the teaching of Self- Awareness 1.0 Creation with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

9. D — Apply the teaching of My 1.0 Creation with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

10. C — Listening to others and living values taught at home and school

11. A — Telling the truth and keeping trust

12. D — Apply the teaching of Wedding with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

13. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of The Bible Story;; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

14. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Jesus Christ; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Baptism of Jesus Jesus Christ; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Wedding; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
